quest.title: Slime Baskets
quest.description: An enthusiastic slime breeder invites you to play with them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Acting Grand Master Jean is prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Slime Breeder
dialogues.text: It's challenge time! Make the Slimes jump through 10 hoops before time limit! Ready... Go!

dialogues.speaker: Slime Breeder
dialogues.text: That's too bad... You couldn't complete the challenge on time.

dialogues.speaker: Slime Breeder
dialogues.text: Congrats on completing the challenge! Thank you, my Slimes had a lot of fun!
